_doc: config seam — the ONLY sahibinden-specific part (kernel.md §10). core/ MUST validate before use (P3): es.host in host_allowlist; source_roots resolve under repo; recipes are data, never eval'd. NO SECRETS here (P5).
_portability: To share: (1) run.java_home is a LOCAL toolchain path — override per-machine via env HEKTOR_FK_JAVA_HOME (else falls back to $JAVA_HOME; toolchain needs JDK 17). (2) es.host/jira.host/qagent.endpoint are internal — point at your org by editing them HERE; es.host MUST also be added to es.host_allowlist (the SSRF seam, deliberately NOT env-overridable).

run._chrome_version_doc: OPTIONAL. When non-empty, rerun.sh passes -Dchrome.version=<v>. hektor-conventions lists it in the mandatory -D set for selenoid launchpads (the box pins a browser image per version); left EMPTY by default because — unlike profile/env.launchpad/ui.browser.type, whose omission has a documented hard failure (SpringBootConfiguration / WorkspacePropertyDefiner NPE / WebDriverFactory NPE) — no such failure is documented for this one, and pinning a version that the box does not host is itself a way to break every run. Set it to the version your testbox serves.

dom_capture._doc: kit-internal tool test, sourced into gradle from the KIT (core/capture-src/) via core/capture.init.gradle --init-script — NEVER in the suite tree. Carries Kure.SEARCH (compile-time Küre rule); @EnabledIfSystemProperty(dump.url) gates it. dom-capture.sh drives it.
